units.function: Typed browser client and compatibility tests for listing flat/grouped company artifact projections.
units.dependencyDirection: The UI imports Paperclip shared server DTOs directly, serializes query parameters into a company path, delegates auth/error behavior to the generic API client and normalizes one legacy response shape.
units.keyDataModels: Artifact kind/project/search/group/limit/cursor query and artifact/group/selected-group response envelope.
units.lifecycle: Build URLSearchParams, GET the company endpoint, convert a bare array or partial envelope into the expected response.
units.testAssessment: Focused UI Vitest passed 8/8. Tests cover parameter omission/encoding, grouped envelopes and legacy arrays. They omit company path encoding, starred mode, abort/cancellation, stable error codes, runtime decoding, auth/data authority, malformed payloads and compatibility deprecation telemetry.
units.designRationale: Keep the artifact page thin by sharing DTOs and tolerating a simpler backend rollout shape.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS Web needs a stable independent Evidence API adapter that can evolve separately from storage/search implementations and bind verified user/Agent authority.
units.companyOsFit: REIMPLEMENT as a Company OS Web adapter over the independent versioned Evidence API. Generate or validate transport DTOs at runtime, encode path IDs, support AbortSignal and stable error codes, pass purpose/visibility inputs through authenticated context, and make compatibility modes explicit/observable/removable. ADAPT URLSearchParams omission/encoding tests.
units.responsibilityConflict: The client has no representation of requesting Principal, accountable human, data contract, approval or evidence integrity, and its own comment incorrectly describes all results as Agent-produced despite human starred documents.
evidence: d8e1004551f159d185570ae789710db998acac80 PAP-10440: group artifacts by task stacks (#7654)
2026-08-19 focused verbose UI Vitest: 8/8 API tests passed
securityFindings: companyId is interpolated into the URL path without encoding and response data is trusted without runtime schema validation.
The client exposes no cancellation/deadline or stable error mapping for potentially expensive evidence queries.
Silent bare-array compatibility can hide backend/schema drift and drops any missing pagination/truncation semantics.

units.function: Generic card and task-stack UI for artifact image/video/text previews, file actions, task navigation, counts and dates.
units.dependencyDirection: React components consume backend-shaped artifact DTOs and paths directly, reuse the Paperclip router/design primitives and embed English copy, media loading and layout behavior.
units.keyDataModels: Artifact media/source/path/title/creator/update projection and grouped issue/count/preview projection.
units.lifecycle: Render media or placeholder; seek video thumbnail; navigate whole card; optionally open/download; render grouped preview and decorative stack count.
units.testAssessment: Focused UI Vitest passed 15/15 component tests, while React emitted a runtime warning that nested anchors are invalid and will cause hydration errors. Tests cover visual variants, video seek fallback, action omission and group stack basics, but rely heavily on class/English-string assertions and omit console-error gating, unsafe URLs, accessibility, keyboard/touch, responsive layouts, reduced-data behavior, media failures, truncation/integrity and responsibility states.
units.designRationale: Create a consistent, compact gallery with fixed aspect ratios and resilient previews across heterogeneous outputs.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs a warm clay-style evidence experience integrated with Agent Boss, office entities, approval and responsibility—not a generic SaaS output-card grid.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE ONLY. Retain the ideas of fixed preview geometry, bounded plain-text excerpts, lazy images, media fallbacks and stack previews. Design new Company OS components around sanitized asset capabilities, separate valid interactive elements, touch/keyboard/mobile access, reduced-data admission and visible producer/responsible-human/approval/data/integrity states. Do not copy the branded/generic card implementation.
units.responsibilityConflict: Cards can display only createdByAgent; human creators, accountable owners, approval decisions, evidence digest/integrity, data authority and invalid provenance are invisible. Incomplete backend group counts are presented as authoritative.
evidence: c90e66bdd6a8cdd8de44c1190dd816fed00318e8 feat(ui): design-system component convergence — Card/Badge adoption, multiplicative radius ladder, unified list surfaces (#9240)
2026-08-19 focused verbose UI Vitest: 15/15 passed, with explicit React nested-anchor hydration warning
securityFindings: Backend-provided href/contentPath/openPath/downloadPath values become navigation, media and download URLs without allowed-scheme/same-origin/capability validation.
ArtifactCard nests Open/Download anchor elements inside the whole-card anchor; React reports invalid HTML and a hydration-error risk, and focus/click semantics are ambiguous.
Every visible video requests metadata and seeks a frame without viewport, reduced-data, concurrency or request-budget admission.
Media errors and invalid provenance silently become generic placeholders, hiding evidence-integrity failures from reviewers.
